name: @qf-jarvis/riya-agent
description: QF Jarvis Riya client-sales behaviour (QFJ-S3-C, ADR-0067). The client-sales half of the agent layer, and nothing else: a closed sales-intent vocabulary, a content-minimised need-discovery contract, and one deterministic turn decision that emits proposal REQUESTS through the merged agent-runtime proposal boundary. Riya is fixed to RIYA/CLIENT and refuses vendor work before any model is reached. It builds no runtime, no router, no state machine, no proposal authority and no ModelReplyPort -- those are owned by ADR-0054/0055/0057/0059/0066 and are reused, never replaced. No prompt text (opaque promptRef only), no model call, no memory, no transport, no persistence, no external action. Every action-like result stays PENDING_CORE_VALIDATION; QuickFurno Core remains final authority. Depends on @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime and zod.
